# International Journal of Arts and Social Science

> IJASS is a peer-reviewed, open-access academic journal (ISSN 2581-7922) publishing monthly research in arts, humanities, and social sciences with an international editorial board.

The journal operates from Delhi, India and features contributions from scholars across Nigeria, Malaysia, and South Africa. It accepts manuscript submissions year-round with specific deadlines for each issue and maintains indexing across multiple academic databases.

- [Editorial Board](https://ijassjournal.com/board.html): Editorial board members including scholars from University of Port Harcourt, Valley View University, and University of South Africa
